information.en: SeedSeg: gold fiducial marker detection in T1-weighted prostate MRI (nnU-Net 5-fold ensemble). Returns the images with the detected marker outlines; per-marker probability and a count flag are in the image comments.
Define the config to be executed by MRD server
Number of implanted markers (K). The K most probable candidates are outlined; fewer candidates than K flags the series for review.
